messages.author: 1f84104095d71529
messages.subject: How can I input a data file permanently to shiny?
parts: My shiny app and its contents are solely based on this data set (csv file). So I need to input the data permanently(as default) , so that if someone opens the app on their system, no need to input the data only result is shown by the app. Thank you

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How can I input a data file permanently to shiny?
parts: Just include the CSV file in the same directory as your ui.R and server.R. If the filename is data.csv you can simply do read.csv("data.csv") or whatever from server.R--the path should be relative to the app folder.
